moodys.citation_text: Nuvance Health Moody's Baa1 carried into 2023; subsequently downgraded.

sp.citation_text: S&P BBB+ on Nuvance entering 2023, subsequently downgraded to BBB Sept 2023.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Moody's downgrade with negative outlook; weakened operating performance and reduced liquidity. FY23 drop in unrestricted net assets nearly $84M, multiple years of low operating profit, operating loss $164M FY23.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Moody's downgrades Nuvance Health to Baa2; outlook negative.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: S&P downgrade reflecting concerns about ability to meet debt obligations, second downgrade since 2022.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Nuvance Health, CT Debt Rating Lowered To 'BBB' From 'BBB+'.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Further weakening; 'next several quarters will be pivotal for Nuvance.' Greater than expected cash losses or failure to demonstrate margin improvement pressures rating further.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Danbury, Conn.-based Nuvance Health was downgraded to a 'Baa3' rating amid weakened operating performance and reduced liquidity.

moodys.citation_text: Baa3 negative through end of window; Northwell merger closed in 2024-Q4 / 2025 transition.

sp.citation_text: BBB negative through end of window.

outcome_class_rationale: Nuvance experienced multiple downgrades within window: Moody's two-step Baa1 -> Baa2 (Jul 2023) -> Baa3 (Aug 2024); S&P single-notch BBB+ -> BBB (Sept 2023). Aggregate of 3 notch movements across 2 agencies qualifies as MULTI_DOWNGRADE. Northwell merger announced Feb 2024 closed in 2024.
